summary: Sandbach United suffered a tough 3-2 defeat to Foley Meir in their opening fixture, with Saul Shotton grabbing a late consolation goal despite the team creating several clear-cut chances they failed to convert. The Bach will be looking to bounce back quickly when they host Stafford Town at home on Saturday, a side expected to challenge for promotion this season. Come Saturday, Sandbach will need to be sharper in front of goal and tighter defensively if they're to get their campaign back on track.
